skills.name: Aulus, Charge!
skills.description: Aulus removes all slow effects and gains 30% extra Movement Speed and 20% Damage Reduction against attacks from the front for 5s. Aulus gains 1% Damage Reduction for every 10 extra Physical Attack, up to 60%.
skills.tips: Allows him to move quite freely on the battlefield. Use this skill wisely, and Aulus will poke, burst, and flee with ease.

skills.name: Undying Fury
skills.description: Aulus bate seu machado de batalha no chão, causando Dano Físico aos inimigos em linha reta e desacelerando-os em 70% por 1.5s. Um rastro de fogo permanece no chão por 5s, causando Dano Físico contínuo e lentidão.
skills.tips: A Ultimate de Aulus é um golpe decisivo nas lutas de equipe. Pode controlar e atingir inimigos em uma ampla área se conjurada no ângulo correto.

skills.name: The Power of Axe
skills.description: Aulus brandishes his axe, dealing 150<font color='#D58E1F'>( +120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area, and enhancing up to 6 of his next Basic Attacks for 3s according to the enemies hit (3 per Hero or Creep, 1 per Minion). Enhanced Basic Attacks gain 100% extra Attack Speed and restore 50 <font color='#47BE34'>(HP)</font> to Aulus.
skills.tips: Aulus' Ultimate is a knockout blow in teamfights. It can control and hit enemies in a wide range if it's cast at the right angle.

skills.name: Fighting Spirit
skills.description:
Aulus adds a stack of <font color='#404495'>(Fighting Spirit)</font> to his axe per second for 3s after dealing damage to any enemy (up to 4 stacks). Each stack grants 3-12 extra <font color='#D58E1F'>(Physical Attack)</font> and 1-4 <font color='#D58E1F'>(Physical Penetration)</font> (scales with <font color='#404495'>(Undying Fury)</font> level).
Aulus also gains 10% extra Movement Speed and 27-125 Basic Attack Damage at max <font color='#404495'>(Fighting Spirit)</font> stacks (scales with level).
skills.tips: Aulus' key skill. Focus on the duration of "Fury Spirit" and try to maintain the full stacks.

items.name: Endless Battle
items.des: Unique Passive - Divine Justice: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 60% Physical Attack as extra True Damage (1.5s cooldown).

items.name: Warrior Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Valor: Gain 4 extra Physical Defense for 3s when taking Physical Damage, up to 20.

items.name: Berserker's Fury
items.des: Unique Passive - Doom: Critical strikes grant 5% extra Physical Attack for 2s.

items.name: Brute Force Breastplate
items.des: Unique Passive - Brute Force: Each second after dealing damage, gain 6 extra Physical Attack and Magic Power and 2% extra Movement Speed for 4s, up to 6 stacks. Gain 15% extra Control Duration Reduction at full stacks.

items.name: Dominance Ice
items.des: Unique Passive - Arctic Cold: Reduces the Attack Speed of nearby enemy heroes to 70% of normal.

items.name: Blade of Despair
items.des: Unique Passive - Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2s (takes effect before the damage is dealt).

builds.tips: For equipment, we recommend this build to ensure the hero's damage output and durability.

counters.tips: Aulus's strong engage and sustained combat capabilities, along with his Control Immunity, makes him a good counter to squishy, low-mobility heroes like Hanabi, Miya, and Gord.
